items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: I said Elizabeth Hall. Frank had a Masonic Hall every Saturday night.

ctx.x: I see. One other question. Mettoyer, did you tell me you played with Bolden sometimes, do you? When you were very young, you played with Bolden?

Well, after Frank, long after, I played with Frank. Frank had a band. It was gone. Frank had changed his band name. It's called his band name, The Eagle Band. Well, he had Buddy. Played with Buddy on his job. I said Elizabeth Hall. Frank had a Masonic Hall every Saturday night. That was Rampart and Padilla. Frank had a Masonic Hall. He was blown, but going off. That play, he wouldn't stop sometimes. Then Frank leaves him going. He got sick then. That's why they kept him home. They just sent him out and all the…
I was wondering about Carnish. When he stopped playing with Bolden, did he stop playing music, or did he keep on playing after that? Willie Carnish on trombone. Did he keep on working around here?
